name: DATAPRP
recent: Dataprep 近期出现多项企业活动：已获 Bursa Securities 批准；同时董事会与管理层出现变动，包括委任 Datuk Wira Shamshuri 为董事长，以及执行董事与 CFO 辞职。此外，公司出现清盘 / 接管相关公告。
notable: 已获 Bursa Securities 批准上市最多 94,209,000 股配售股份。
Datuk Wira Shamshuri Bin Abdul Majid 于 2026 年 11 月 20 日获委任为董事长。
公司出现清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理相关公告。
risks: 私下配售最多 10% 新股，可能对现有股东持股造成摊薄。
执行董事与 CFO 在数日内相继辞职，均表示个人原因。
董事长 Datuk Wira Shamshuri 在闭市期间进行股份交易，175,562,200 股。
earnings: 最新财报（截至 2025 年 3 月 31 日）显示营收为 MYR 983,000，净亏损为 MYR 3,950,000，净利率为 -401.8%。

news.title: Dataprep Holdings Bhd Announces Appointment of Datuk Wira Shamshuri Bin Abdul Majid as Chairman, Effective from 20 November 2026
Dataprep Appoints Datuk Wira Shamshuri As New Chairman
Datuk Shamsuri Acquires 19 Million Shares In Dataprep After Disposing 18 Million In Oct
Dataprep Executive Director And CFO Resign Within Days, Both Cite Personal Reasons
Dataprep chair Wan Ahmad Rudirman exits
Dataprep executive chairman Wan Ahmad Rudirman resigns
Dataprep Executive Chairman Dr Wan Rudirman Resigns
Dataprep plans private placement to raise up to RM6m

recent_en: Dataprep has seen several corporate developments recently: a proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares, which has been approved by Bursa Securities; board and management changes, including the appointment of Datuk Wira Shamshuri as Chairman and the resignations of an Executive Director and the CFO. The company also made winding-up/receivership related announcements.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares; Bursa Securities approved the listing of up to 94,209,000 placement shares.
Datuk Wira Shamshuri Bin Abdul Majid was appointed Chairman effective 20 November 2026.
The company made winding-up/receivership/restraining order/special administrator related announcements.
risks_en: Private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
The Executive Director and CFO resigned within days of each other, both citing personal reasons.
Chairman Datuk Wira Shamshuri traded shares during the closed period, including acquiring 7,175,000 shares and disposing of 6,562,200 shares on the same day.
earnings_en: The latest financial results (period ended 31 March 2025) show revenue of MYR 983,000, a net loss of MYR 3,950,000, and a net margin of -401.8%.
